snippet.title: FOUNTAINS - Console Announcement Trailer | Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, PC
snippet.description:
Master high-skilled combat and explore a vast, interconnected world.
FOUNTAINS is a soulslike action-RPG built around fighting your way through a maze-like, seamless world.

⚔️ Incoming Update to the Steam version.
📅 Releasing along with a new DLC later this year.
🎮 Coming to Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S!
